During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a small-time [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manufacturing '''company''' was found to be mass-producing robotic doubles for the freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Investigation|Shrouded Identities}}</ref>
